description: Persist a source-first clone job into a filesystem-backed async queue for later worker execution.

clone_args.description: Additional clone_reference_url arguments stored with the job (same names as that tool, e.g. wait_seconds, breakpoint_profiles).

max_attempts.description: Maximum run attempts before the job is marked failed (1-10, default 2).

metadata.description: Free-form JSON stored with the job, e.g. a ticket id.

output_dir.description: Directory the job writes its clone and reports into.

queue_root.description: Directory holding the filesystem job queue; created if missing.

retry_delay_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a failed attempt (default 30).

url.description: Public http(s) URL to clone when the job runs.

name: enqueue_clone_job
